text:
olivia: Morning — quick availability check: vendor reports ~12 H100 slots in uk-east for the rest of the week. Anyone planning low-latency canaries there?
raj: We have a real-time embeds canary scheduled tomorrow, would like to claim 4 slots. Can we get a soft hold?
cassie: I'll add 4 to the procurement sheet and tag them in Terraform. Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/procurement (placeholder). Tags: team=embeddings, purpose=canary, latency_slo=50ms.
indra: Heads-up — vendor mentioned NIC firmware pending on some racks. Pinging vendor to confirm which racks are affected.
vendor-bot: Vendor update: NIC firmware upgrade pending on 5 racks; patch expected Thu 18:00 UTC. Current slots are compute-only; NIC perf may be degraded until patch.
raj: That could bump p95. We prefer uk-east for regional testing, but if NICs hurt p95 we should fallback to eu-west for critical paths.
olivia: Proposal: reserve 4 slots but mark them "latency-experimental". Update smart-routing: prefer uk-east but fail over to eu-west if p95 > 70ms over a 5m window. Can someone add the policy?
cassie: I'll open a tiny infra PR for the routing policy. PR: https://git.redwood/infrarouting/pulls/1234 — includes JSON policy snippet. @indra can you review?
indra: On it. Quick note: turn KV cache pinning OFF for the canary so we measure cold-starts too.
raj: Also need a quota bump for project redwood-embeds-prod — I'm filing a cloud-console ticket. Should we attach cost estimate to the ticket?
olivia: Yes, please attach an estimate. Ballpark is ~$1.6k/week for the reserved 4 slots (inc burst). Put the number in the ticket so procurement has context.
indra: Reviewed PR 1234, left one minor nit about metric naming (use embed_latency.p95). Cassie can you address and re-request review?
cassie: Fixed the metric name and updated policy. Re-requested review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: infra-routing PR #1234 merged by cassie. Canary rollout scheduled for 03:15 UTC.
olivia: Great — after the canary finishes let's do a 1hr telemetry deep-dive with SRE to validate p95 and routing behavior. I'll send a calendar invite.
raj: Thanks all — I'll queue the quota ticket and link the procurement sheet.
cassie: Added notes in procurement sheet with vendor rack IDs and the Terraform tag names.
indra: Will watch the canary and validate metrics. Ping me if rollout shows >70ms p95 so I can trigger failover.
olivia: Perfect, thanks team.
